positive_scope: Seven native identities with original nominal capacities, actual item/fluid capability registration, Juicer zero fluid-input slots and no item automation, basic input fluid gates, manual/held recipe processing and saving hooks exist.
Recipe output capacity is simulated before commit; this does not validate output temperature/density/gas/simple flags because the low-level fill does not enforce them.

Original input-fluid withdrawal by a held container is distinct from ordinary output-only fluid automation. Duplicate-item admission is scoped to the native sided automatic callback, not plain ST.move hand transfer.

Source Root updateAdjacentInventories actually sends six-side callbacks. Extend 172 for Bath/Juicer successful recipes and the MixingBowl fluid-container branch; do not infer all manual recipe branches invoke it.

Source/current rain entry and ordinary formula are present, but SERVER_TIME versus saved world time phase, high custom climate and complete environmental/physical behavior remain separate pending work.
limits: 18 automatic admission roles, 24 output amount cases, five rotating-selector phases and one empty-output/input-drain scenario are source projections, not actual Java, handlers, fluids, recipes or game runs.

Four Bath variants take a native item-model render path instead of the original material dust surface; output-slot 7..11 selection is also broader. Existing bowl glow 008 and Bath dynamic recipes 050 are not repaired or re-counted.

Native exhaustion evidence is rehashed from batch98 cached entries only; no new javap, compile, Gradle, test, game, build or push. Current field writes do not prove independent saved-world restart or old saves.

Do not restore discarded/unsafe output arithmetic, missed bounds checks or source display omissions during formatting. Full recipe reachability/overrides, fluid physical cases, viewer buttons, powered mixing, tools and rendering frames remain unverified.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash original/current/platform views and reused native entries; trace sided automatic admission, public fluid drain callbacks, processing amount/physical gates, source/render consumers and concrete notification/exhaustion calls. Compare git snapshots and full tokens/literal positions/comments/directives. No target, recipe, handler, player or game execution.
